Name: Balanced
Description: Uniformly distributed priorities (1-10), burst times (2-20), staggered arrivals.

Name: Priority Skew
Description: Concentration in lower priorities (75% prio 7-10, burst 15-30; 25% prio 1-4, burst 3-8).

Name: Short and Long Burst Mixture
Description: Bimodal distribution: 50% short interactive (1-4 ticks), 50% long CPU-bound (25-50 ticks).

Name: Heavy Contention
Description: Dense clustered arrivals (t in [0, 5]), creating high immediate ready-queue competition.

Name: Staggered Arrivals
Description: Processes arrive in wave clusters with distinct idle gaps between arrival phases.

Name: Starvation-Prone
Description: Initial lower-priority batch jobs trapped behind continuous stream of higher-priority tasks.

Name: Mixed Realistic Workload
Description: Realistic multi-tier mix (40% interactive, 35% normal, 25% batch) with dynamic arrival bursts.
